from scipy import ndimage
def solve(g):
    g = np.array(g); o = g.copy()
    H,W = g.shape
    lab,n = ndimage.label(g==3)
    boxes = ndimage.find_objects(lab)
    active = np.zeros_like(g, bool)
    for sl in boxes:
        active[sl] |= (g[sl]==2)
    for r,c in np.argwhere(active):
        for a in range(max(0,r-1),min(H,r+2)):
            for b in range(max(0,c-1),min(W,c+2)):
                if (a,b)!=(r,c) and o[a,b]!=2: o[a,b]=1
    return o
